TWINPOWER TURBO ENGINES.
The M235i’s thunderous M Performance TwinPower Turbo 3.0-liter 320-hp engine
catapults the Coupe from 0–60 in an exhilarating 4.6 seconds1; its sibling, the 2.0-liter
240-hp-equipped 228i, chases closely behind, reaching 60 mph in a mere 5.4 seconds.1
Both engines also provide excellent fuel economy thanks to BMW’s award-winning
high-precision direct injection, Valvetronic, Double-VANOS and twin-scroll turbocharger
technologies. As the 2 Series breathes air in, it takes your breath away.
SPORT SUSPENSION.
With a lightweight aluminum front suspension, 4-wheel ventilated disc brakes
and Dynamic Traction Control (DTC), the 2 Series is designed to be near
telepathic in its responses. The Track Handling Package adds Variable Sport
Steering, Adaptive M Suspension, M Sport brakes, and specifically designed
non-run-flat Michelin® Pilot Super Sport performance tires.2, 3
AN EXTERIOR DESIGNED FOR DOUBLE TAKES.
As if carved from a single piece of steel, the angular surfaces offer aerodynamic
excellence and aesthetic purity, minimizing drag and redirecting airflow, while the
optional M Sport Package ups the ante with M-style rocker panels, front bumper,
and rear diffuser.3 The wind tunnel-tested rear spoiler increases downforce at
high speeds for enhanced rear-end traction, and with 18-inch light alloy wheels,
you’ll be gripping asphalt and attention in equal measure.

COMFORTABLE QUARTERS
IN TIGHT CORNERS.
The BMW 2 Series refocuses the driving experience on you: the driver. Its cockpit exhibits
the apex of convenience and functional design, and offers the perfect driving environment
for the open road. The ergonomic nature of the BMW 2 Series interior exemplifies a thorough
commitment to driver orientation. To put it simply, whatever you need is easily accessible.
Intelligent storage compartments secured during sporty maneuvers. Setting a higher standard
in safety and convenience, BMW ConnectedDrive® puts you in control. Take a call hands-free,
access your favorite music playlist, and get turn-by-turn directions with Advanced Real Time
Traffic Information. Other features, like the multi-function sport steering wheel and Sport
Automatic transmission with paddle shifters, place you in an immersive driving environment.
Not only does the BMW 2 Series handle any challenge the road may bring, it does so while
offering comfort and luxury like never before.

--- page 9 ---
ALL SKY, NO LIMITS.
Indulge your senses in the 2 Series Convertible, available in both the 228i and
M235i models. The automatic softtop can be opened and closed in 20 seconds,
and can even be operated while moving at speeds up to 30 mph. With three
distinct top colors to choose from, you can easily personalize your convertible
while complementing the dynamic body style and bold paint colors. The softtop
offers optimized acoustics and enhanced soundproofing as a result of additional
insulation in the fabric, so when the M235i’s exuberant 320-hp engine lets loose,
all you’ll hear is the open road calling your name. From Sunday evening joyrides
to Monday morning commutes, the BMW 2 Series Convertible ensures that you
won’t just feel the wind in your hair, you’ll feel it in your soul.
